subject: Security next steps — questionnaire path and evidence requests for Gaines Health
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Gaines <emma@gaineshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Security next steps — questionnaire path and evidence requests for Gaines Health

Hi Emma — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security front so we stay aligned: 

1) Our ask: confirm which vendor questionnaire you prefer us to complete — SIG Lite (preferred for speed), CAIQ (if you need control-plane detail), or your custom PDF.
2) Evidence window: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report (most recent, June 2026), encryption config snippets, and a short data flow diagram.
3) Residency/compliance flags: you mentioned HIPAA for PHI handling and EU residency for a small subset of telemetry — can you confirm estimated % of EU users and whether PHI will be routed to our private deployment?

Attachments: I attached a short guide that maps the SIG/CAIQ fields to the evidence bundles we typically provide. If you want us to start on a prefilling approach, tell us which questionnaire and point person.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm questionnaire choice and primary contact (Emma/Naveen) by end of week.
- We send a prefilling package + evidence list within 48 hours of confirmation.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[attachment: SIG_selection_guide.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Emma Gaines <emma@gaineshealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naveen Reddy <naveen@gaineshealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security next steps — questionnaire path and evidence requests for Gaines Health

Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below and a couple clarifying questions: 

1) We want to start with SIG Lite to move faster. If gaps appear later we'll escalate to full SIG.
2) EU residency: approx 8–10% of our monthly active users; PHI will be processed in US but must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
3) Can you confirm whether your hosted API supports a BAA and whether SOC 2 report includes encryption key management controls?

Also — Naveen (copied) will be the primary security contact and will own the questionnaire. Please send the prefilling checklist to him.

Best,
Emma
Director of Product, Gaines Health

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security next steps — questionnaire path and evidence requests for Gaines Health

Naveen — great, we'll proceed with SIG Lite prefilling. Quick items for your team so we can scope properly: 

- Evidence we will include in prefilling: SOC 2 Type II (June 2026), encryption-at-rest config (AES-256 details), TLS configs, key rotation cadence notes, and a 1-page data flow.
- HIPAA/BAA: we can execute a BAA for hosted customers — I attached our standard BAA excerpt and a short mapping of SOC 2 controls to HIPAA safeguards. Please confirm any vendor-specific clauses you need.
- EU user telemetry: for the ~8–10% EU population, we can route analytics to the EU region; confirm if that satisfies your residency need or whether you require full data residency for any PII.

Action items for Redwood: Marissa will own the evidence bundle and will upload a DataFlowDiagram for your review. Karthik will help map SIG Lite fields to the evidence items and flag any known gaps.

Attachments: DataFlowDiagram.png (high-level).

Can you confirm the date you'd like the prefilling package by? We can deliver within 48 hours after you confirm any custom clauses on the BAA.

—
Vivek
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[attachment: DataFlowDiagram.png (image/png)]

From: Naveen Reddy <naveen@gaineshealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Emma Gaines <emma@gaineshealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security next steps — questionnaire path and evidence requests for Gaines Health

Thanks Vivek — that timeline works. Please deliver the prefilling package by Monday (Nov 2). Two quick clarifications before you send: 

1) For the BAA, we have two non-standard asks: (a) explicit subcontractor list for any third-party infra providers your private deployments may use; (b) a 90-day breach notification clause. Can you note whether Redwood accepts those or wants to discuss redlines?
2) For SIG Lite prefilling: please mark any fields that you leave blank because evidence is 'in progress' — we will track those as open items.

If you can confirm those two points in your delivery, we should be able to move quickly. Appreciate the coordination.

Best,
Naveen
Security Operations, Gaines Health
